article: Getting started with Qt in VS Code
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, including current extension-pack variants, installation workflow, SDK/compiler/CMake prerequisites, Qt kit registration, CMake project setup, C++ example, Designer support, telemetry disclosure, links, and publication metadata.
findings: Updated the extension-pack workflow and distinguished Qt C++/Qt Quick, Qt for Python, and WebAssembly packs.
Clarified Qt SDK and toolchain prerequisites and corrected the claim that the extension pack itself supplies build components.
Replaced an incomplete CMake fragment with a minimal Qt Widgets application and a complete target-based CMake example.
Added current Qt extension setup, registration, CMake, and VS Code references, plus a concise telemetry disclosure.
Preserved the original publication date (2024-09-13) and recorded lastmod (2026-11-24).
